_readme: Data of the charts in docs/img/, drawn by scripts/dev/make_charts.py. Every value is copied from the measured record named in its chart's sources; add a row when a milestone measures something new, then run the script. Bars: label, values (one per series), optional text shown instead of the first value, optional muted (grey: a comparison, not Red Lite).

charts.title: Decode speed, M4 Max 48 GiB, IQ2_XXS, every expert resident
charts.note: bench_m4.sh: 256 greedy tokens, median of 3 cooled runs. MTP: median of six prompts, 256 tokens each, output identical. 0.9.1 and 0.9.2 were measured the same day (2026-10-08), when llama.cpp gave 69.25; the other bars on their release days.

charts.title: Prompt ingestion, 8192 tokens, M4 Max 48 GiB, IQ2_XXS, 4 GiB expert cache
charts.note: bench_m4.sh prefill8192, median of 3 cooled runs; llama.cpp holds every weight resident.

charts.title: MTP speculative decoding, M4 Max 48 GiB, IQ2_XXS, every expert resident
charts.note: 256 greedy tokens per prompt, alternated runs with 40 s cooling; output identical token for token.

charts.title: Decode speed, M4 Pro 24 GiB, IQ2_XXS
charts.note: 4 GiB cache: about 5 GiB in use. All resident: GPU limit raised with sudo sysctl iogpu.wired_limit_mb (18-20 GiB in use). llama.cpp launcher: whole model resident, range of its sweep. Six-prompt medians except dev18 and llama.cpp.

charts.title: Expert cache options on a 24 GiB Mac (M4 Pro, 4 GiB cache, IQ2_XXS)
charts.note: small_mac_ab.sh: six prompts x 256 tokens, 60 s cooling, median decode. Cache bias changes the output (opt-in).

charts.title: Where one decode token's GPU time goes (M4 Max, IQ2_XXS, dev38)
charts.note: RL_ENGINE_PROFILE=1, every expert resident, each stage timed on its own (sum 12.0 ms). A real token takes 12.1 ms wall, 11.7 ms of GPU.

charts.title: Greedy answers vs Qwen's own API, 235 prompts (M4 Max, every expert resident)
charts.note: Word for word against Alibaba Cloud's qwen3-next-80b-a3b-instruct (temperature 0, top_k 1, 128 tokens). Same engine for both files: the difference between them is the quantization.
series: median share of words matching from the start

charts.title: MTP against prompt length, M4 Pro 24 GiB (every expert resident, E3 file)
charts.note: 160 greedy tokens, 16K context, 512-token chunks, GPU limit 21,741 MiB. At 16.8K MTP was slower (37.2 -> 32.6, dev53). The M4 Max still gains +2 % at 16.8K.

charts.title: Two server requests, M4 Pro 24 GiB (every expert resident, E3 file)
charts.note: Total throughput of two greedy 200-token answers, one after the other vs at the same time (--parallel 2). One run each; identical answers.

charts.title: Perplexity of 19.3 GB files of the same model (lower is better)
charts.note: Frozen corpus, ctx 512, 111 chunks, M4 Max. R: Bartowski's IQ2_XXS scheme rebuilt; E3: precise expert layers moved to 37-47 (dev54); F1/F2: dense weights at IQ3_XXS / Q4_K (dev58).

charts.title: Coding-agent tasks passed (pi agent, 5 tasks x 3 runs)
charts.note: Scripted grading, every expert resident, 32K context. F2 before dev59b/dev60: arguments re-serialized by the agent broke the state reuse, and wrong closing brackets were not repaired.

bars.label: F2, M4 Max, before the fixes

charts.title: Decode on a 24 GiB Mac: three ways to run it (M4 Pro)
charts.note: F2 perplexity 15.38, IQ3_XXS 14.29 (lower is better). Resident: raised GPU limit, 256 tokens, median of 3 (dev58). 4 GiB cache: default GPU limit, six prompts x 256 tokens, cache-aware routing (dev61).

charts.title: Harder coding-agent tasks on a real repository (pi agent, M4 Max)
charts.note: 4 tasks: add --json to redlite models with a test, explain the C server's stop sequences, fix a planted planner bug, a 4-prompt session. Qwen API 3 runs, Qwen3-Coder-Next 5, F2 3.

charts.title: Qwen3-Coder-Next 2-bit files on harder agent tasks (pi agent, repository suite)
charts.note: 4 tasks x 3 runs per file and Mac, every expert resident, 32K context, server sampling defaults. M4 Pro 24 GiB: 600 s limit, pi 1.0.2; M4 Max 48 GiB: 900 s, pi 0.84.4. CE3 and CF2 are Red Lite quantizations of the same size (dev63).

charts.title: Agent loops against sampling temperature (Qwen3-Coder-Next IQ2_XXS, M4 Pro 24 GiB)
charts.note: A loop: a task stopped at the 600 s limit after 40 or more requests. Repository suite, 3 runs per setting. C adds presence_penalty 1.0 to temperature 1.0. Passes 7-9 of 12 are within noise.

charts.title: 48 GiB files of Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct: perplexity against Bartowski's IQ3_XXS
charts.note: Frozen text corpus (111 chunks) and code corpus (90 chunks), ctx 512, M4 Max. G1: Q8_0 dense; G2: IQ3_S experts (31.24 GiB, fits with MTP); G3: both (31.99 GiB, MTP above the 70 % rule). Bars show the reduction.

charts.title: Hard coding-agent tasks against the context window (pi agent, Qwen3-Coder-Next)
charts.note: Six harder tasks on a copy of this repository, three runs per setting, temperature 0.3, 900 s per task (dev65). The 24 GiB Mac at 64K streams experts from the SSD, so more tasks hit the time limit.

charts.title: Decode speed at long prompts on the M4 Max 48 GiB (Red Lite CF2, every expert resident)
charts.note: A prompt made of this repository's code with three passphrases at 10/50/90 %, all three found at every length; decode of the answer through redlite-server before (0.8.0) and after the dev66 decode attention change, 90 W charger. Ingestion of the prompt took 2, 6.7 and 24 minutes.

charts.title: Decode in coding-agent sessions with prompt lookup (M4 Max 48 GiB, Red Lite CF2)
charts.note: The dev65 hard suite with pi, three runs each, decode speed from the server logs grouped by the context at the start of each answer. Prompt lookup drafts the next token from the context and verifies it exactly: the output is unchanged (dev70).
